why: Items mix arguing whether scripts are fair with running/defending scripts, so the gate boundary between arguing over automation and actually running it looks easiest to slip.

why.T3-016: The item leads with explaining what r/place is and how placing works (C0625892, C0196181, C1476405, C0022289), matching T3-016's gate of questions/answers about the event itself.
why.T3-037: Four concepts weigh the canvas as a whole rather than explain it — questioning destruction, calling it wasted time, defending competition (C0008482, C0515910, C0057907, C1394098) — a distinct practice T3-016's gate does not reach.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: A single T3-016 placement would fail to carry the four concepts that argue the canvas's worth (wasted time, defending competition, why destroy), which is a judgement of the canvas rather than an explanation of it.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0057907 and C1394098 argue the canvas as a whole — wasted time and defending competition — satisfying T3-037's gate.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-037; dropping it loses the item's judgement of the canvas, leaving only the explanation.

why.T3-080: The material enacts a dispute over one political/national sign (the Serbian heart): a call to remove it, coordinate support, and a rebuke (C1283108, C0980062), matching T3-080's gate of a symbol argued over for its politics rather than the mere doing of an attack.

why.T3-070: The item's largest share is coordinates, templates, guides and plans posted for placers to follow (C1295789, C1492172, C0772489, C0503887, C1467985, C0936375 etc.), satisfying T3-070's gate with the directions leading.
why.T3-002: A distinct set of concepts calls the room's members to come and place and to join (C0130022, C1343580, C1226279, C1352095, C0073883), which T3-070's direction-sharing gate does not reach.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: A single T3-070 placement would fail to carry the repeated open calls for hands to join and defend the flag (C0130022, C1343580, C1226279, C1352095), which is asking members to place rather than circulating what to place.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0130022, C1343580 and C1226279 call on the room's members to come and place, satisfying T3-002's gate with a distinct supporting concept.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-002; dropping it loses the rallying-to-place practice, leaving the directions that already carry the work.

why.T3-006: The most emphatic strain is calls and refusals aiming to destroy or overwrite the neighbour's art (C0835495 'get rid of the lady', C0816591, and the repeated 'fuk the kiki' at C0864937, C0013388, C0926288), matching T3-006's gate of attacks meant to destroy or erase.
why.T3-024: A distinct restraint practice appears — not intruding on the kiwi, leaving it because it was there first, telling others not to touch work left of Ace Attorney (C0023041, C1119765, C0079581) — which T3-006's destruction gate does not reach.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: A single T3-006 placement would fail to carry the going-around-and-sparing strain (C0023041, C1119765, C0079581), which is restraint toward others' work rather than an attack on it.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0023041 refuses to intrude on the kiwi makers and C0079581 tells people not to touch the cyan box, satisfying T3-024's gate of restraint by the room's own choice.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-024; dropping it loses the restraint-by-choice practice, leaving the destruction calls that lead the item.

why.T3-014: The largest group sets up and sends members to a Discord for place discussion (C1394911, C0944504, C1290125, C0621534, C0845949, C1526846), matching T3-014's gate of moving the talk into a chat.
why.T3-075: A distinct set objects that r/place posts crowd the hockey feed and asks them to stop (C1146237, C0502857, C0418593, C1006897, C0284626), which T3-014's moving gate does not reach.
why.T3-015: A third practice asks for one megathread to gather the canvas talk (C0456353, C0937501, C0968100), which neither the chat move nor the complaint reaches.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: A single T3-014 placement would fail to carry the members objecting that r/place posts crowd the hockey feed and asking them to stop (C1146237, C0502857, C0284626), which is complaint about the flood, not the move to chat.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C1146237 and C0284626 demand the pixel talk stop or be contained, satisfying T3-075's gate with distinct support.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-075; dropping it loses the complaint that drives the moving, leaving the mechanisms.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: Neither T3-014's chat-move nor T3-075's objection reaches the requests for one pinned megathread inside the sub to gather the canvas talk (C0456353, C0937501).
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0456353 and C0937501 ask for a megathread, satisfying T3-015's gate of gathering canvas talk into one thread.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-015; dropping it loses the megathread route, leaving the chat move and the complaint.

why.T3-038: The bulk places the crest and reports its state — placed at 820,320, waiting after first placement, L done, S started, securing the gold border, finished building then fixing (C0588536, C0123623, C1283780, C0857973, C1492854) — matching T3-038's gate of building and reporting the mark.

why.T3-048: The single concept responds in the room to an April Fools prank whose maker is the show the sub follows, and the response bears on how that joke landed (C1080490) — closest to T3-048's gate of members reacting to the maker's own April Fools joke, though the reaction is support rather than judgement.
